shortDescription: India's Titan NSE:TITAN on Tuesday reported a 25% rise in sales in its consumer business in the second quarter, driven by demand for jewellery, watches and eyewear.Here are some more details:

children: on Tuesday reported a 25% rise in sales in its consumer business in the second quarter, driven by demand for jewellery, watches and eyewear.
The company, which houses brands like Tanishq and CaratLane, added 78 stores in the July-September quarter, taking its total store count to 3,758
Its jewellery business grew 21% during the quarter, driven by double-digit growth in average transaction values as gold prices remained high
Titan said the jewellry business also maintained a double-digit growth momentum in North America during the quarter
The company's watches business, which includes brands such as Fastrack and Sonata, grew 30% during the quarter, while its eyewear business posted 28% growth from a year earlier
The results come as Indian consumer companies signal resilient demand
